messages:
sasha: Quick thread to lock the internal announce + rollback plan for tomorrow's deploy (v2.3.1-rc3). Need a couple quick sign-offs.

sasha: Change window: 2026-03-25 03:00-04:00 UTC. Rollout plan: canary 5% for 12m -> 50% for 6m -> full. Fallback target: v2.2-stable. We'll run the DB migration at canary start.

maria: Sounds good. Can we make the 5% canary 12m (gives us one full telemetry cycle)? +1 otherwise.

raj: +1 on the timing. Note on migration: step 2 can take a short table lock (~40-60s). Ops, please abort migration if lock exceeds 60s and escalate.

elaine: Draft internal announce: "Heads-up: deploying v2.3.1-rc3 (perf & routing fixes). Canary 5% then progressive rollout. Expect brief warmup on embeddings; some requests may see higher latency until caches prime. Oncall to monitor dashboards; rollback criteria pinned." Want me to post this to the channel?

sasha: Please post after adding the exact rollback triggers below.

maria: Proposing rollback triggers: 
- sustained error rate >= 3.0% for 2m OR
- p99 latency increase >= 250ms vs baseline for 5m OR
- embeddings tail (99th) latency jump > 300ms for 5m
If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to v2.2-stable and create incident ticket.

raj: Fine with those, except lower the error-rate window to 90s (2m -> 90s) so we react faster.

sasha: Updated: error-rate >= 3.0% for 90s. Other thresholds unchanged.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @sasha: start=2026-03-25T03:00:00Z, canary=5%, stages=12m,6m,full, fallback=v2.2-stable. CLI: `/deploy release v2.3.1-rc3 --canary 5% --stages 12m,6m,full --fallback v2.2-stable --migrate-at-canary`

ops-standby: We'll be covering the window. Please ping @ops-standby when canary begins and attach the runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/rollback-v2.3.1-rc3.

elaine: I'll post the internal announce now and attach the release notes + rollback runbook links. Posting text: "Deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC: v2.3.1-rc3 (perf & routing fixes). Canary 5%. Warmup expected for embeddings. Oncall please watch errors & latency. Rollback criteria pinned."

maria: +1 to that copy. Add a one-line note about observing DB locks during migration.

elaine: Added DB lock note to the pin. Posted and pinned in #eng-releases; tagged @ops-standby and @oncall. Link included: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/v2.3.1-rc3

ops-standby: Ack. Runbook open and monitors ready. We'll post an "canary started" update when the deploy-bot kicks off. :thumbsup:

sasha: Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless anything changes. If you see an unexpected spike, reply here and we'll coordinate rollback.
